GlacialStorm.name: Glacial Storm
GlacialStorm.tooltip:
Toggle: Anivia calls forth a driving rain of ice and hail that Slows enemies by @SlowAmount@% and deals @TotalDamagePerSecond@ magic damage per second. The storm increases in size over @GrowthTime@ seconds.

When the storm is fully formed, it Chills, Slows by @SlowPercentEmpoweredTT@%, and does @EmpoweredDamagePerSecondTooltipOnly@ magic damage per second instead.
The storm ends if Anivia is too far away.

RebirthMarker.name: Rebirth
RebirthMarker.tooltip: Upon taking fatal damage, Anivia reverts to an egg, healing to full Health and receiving <Level>@BonusResists@</Level> <scaleArmor>Armor</scaleArmor> and <scaleMR>Magic Resist</scaleMR>. If she survives for 6 seconds, she is reborn.

FlashFrost.name: Flash Frost
FlashFrost.tooltip:
Anivia fires a massive chunk of ice, dealing @TotalPassthroughDamage@ magic damage and Chilling enemies for @SlowDuration@ seconds, Slowing them by @Spell.GlacialStorm:SlowAmount@%. At the end of its range, the ice detonates, Stunning enemies for @StunDuration@ seconds and dealing @TotalExplosionDamage@ magic damage.

Anivia can Recast this ability while the ice flies to detonate it early.

Frostbite.name: Frostbite
Frostbite.tooltip: Anivia blasts an enemy with a freezing wind, dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>. Against <keywordMajor>Chilled</keywordMajor> enemies, Anivia deals <magicDamage>@EmpoweredDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> instead.

Crystallize.name: Crystallize
Crystallize.tooltip: Anivia summons a wall of ice @WallWidth@ units wide. The wall lasts for @WallDuration@ seconds before it melts.
